preprocessing_basis: The pinned PaddleX mobile predictor maps resize_long960 to limit_side_len960 and limit_typemax through its existing model-specific default helper. Explicitly retain that CPU predictor resize path and official0.3/0.6/1.5 thresholds; no output-driven alternatives.
engine_basis: Plain fp32 Paddle static CPU execution with one thread; optimized MKL-DNN/HPI/CINN/TensorRT paths are explicitly disabled before outputs, rather than selected after a result.
attempt_isolation: One fresh Node parent and Python child in one fresh container/cgroup per page; separate fresh-process cold blank first. This does not qualify a long-lived Node parent or OS-page-cache-cold latency.
raw_output_policy: Preserve upstream returned rec_texts, rec_scores, dt_polys, rec_polys, rec_boxes and optional detector scores in their returned order. Arabic strings are already post-upstream bidi display transformation, not pre-transformation network output.
node_projection: Only rec_texts.join(newline).trim(); no normalization, reversal, reordering, filtering or expected-text repair. Preserve raw upstream output separately.
qualification_scope: Actual processUploadedDocumentOcr runs with a synthetic gateway and explicit experimental reader. Default readUploadedPdfPage and production engine schema remain unchanged; no production gateway, customer data or provider calls.
stop_policy: Stop and retain remaining-case not-run denominators on resource failure, timeout, malformed engine/protocol output, effective-config mismatch or frozen-input drift. Text mismatch alone is retained and does not trigger tuning or stop later frozen pages. Cold blank must complete with empty projected text before the campaign starts.
